examples.clean: Bob has 5 books. Kim has 9 books. Jim has 9 books. Ted has 4 books. Amy has 2 books. Jim's books minus Ted's books make Fay's books. Fay's books minus Bob's books make Kate's books. Ben has the number of books Kate has, plus 4. Cal holds Ben's books multiplied by Amy's books. How many books does Cal have?
